login.title: Welcome back
login.lead: Enter your password and the database is decrypted. Nothing leaves your computer.
login.decrypting: Decrypting the database – the first unlock after a start takes a few seconds.

recover.title: Recover access
recover.lead: Enter the 24-character recovery key you saved at setup. You then set a new password.
recover.keyHint: The moony-recovery-key.txt file or your copy from the password manager.
recover.verifying: Verifying the recovery key – this can take a few seconds
recover.takesSeconds: Verifying the key takes a few seconds
recover.newKeyLead: The old key no longer works. This one is the only way to your data if you forget the password again.

recoveryKey.savedElsewhere: I have the key stored safely outside this computer
recoveryKey.shownOnce: The key is shown only once
recoveryKey.folderNote: The key works only together with the files in Moony's data folder (salt, key.enc, recovery.enc) – back up that folder too.

validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters

toast.saveRecoveryKey: Please save your recovery key before continuing.
toast.setupCompleteDesc: Your account has been created successfully.
toast.saveNewRecoveryKey: Please save your new recovery key before continuing.

welcome.title: Your data stays with you
welcome.subtitle: Moony stores everything in an encrypted database on this computer. No cloud, no account with us.

encryption.title: AES-256 encryption
encryption.text: – only your password opens the database; documents and photos sit next to it as ordinary files.

localOnly.title: No cloud
localOnly.text: – nothing is sent anywhere; you back up the data folder yourself.

marketData.title: Market data
marketData.text: – only the prices of the stocks, currencies and crypto you track are fetched (Yahoo Finance, CoinGecko, ECB). The app works offline too.

welcome.currencyHint: Totals and charts are shown in this currency. Each account keeps its own.
welcome.countryHint: The country picks the categorization rules and statement formats offered.

account.title: Create your account
account.subtitle: The password encrypts the database. It can only be reset with the recovery key from the next step.
account.name: First name
account.emailPlaceholder: for your own reference, never sent anywhere

strength.weak: Too short – use at least {{min}} characters.
strength.fair: OK. A longer passphrase is even better.

recovery.title: Save your recovery key
recovery.subtitle: The only way to your data if you forget the password. Store it outside this computer – in a password manager, printed, or in a file on an external drive.
recovery.fileNote: This key resets your Moony password. It works only together with the files in Moony's data folder (salt, key.enc, recovery.enc), so back up that folder as well. Keep this file private.
recovery.verifyHint: Type the two requested groups from your copy of the key.
recovery.mismatch: That does not match the key above. Check your copy.
recovery.discarded: Setup cancelled – a new key will be generated when you continue again.
recovery.creating: Creating your encrypted database… this takes a few seconds.

areas.title: What do you want to track?
areas.subtitle: Pick the areas and see on the right what your overview will look like. You can change this any time in Settings.

accounts.title: Accounts & cashflow
accounts.description: Bank accounts, statement imports, categories, budgets.

investments.title: Investments
investments.description: Stocks and ETFs, crypto, bonds and other assets with automatic prices.

realEstate.title: Real estate
realEstate.description: Value, rent, costs, photos and documents of your flat or house.

liabilities.title: Loans & insurance
liabilities.description: Mortgages and loans with a repayment schedule, policies and their anniversaries.

areas.rulesTitle: Categorization rules for {{country}} turn on automatically
areas.rulesNote: Statements from banks in your country are categorized right after the import.
areas.hint: Hidden pages keep working; they just leave the menu.

firstAccount.title: Your first bank account
firstAccount.subtitle: A name and a balance are enough. Import a statement right away, or any time later.
firstAccount.name: Account name
firstAccount.balanceHint: Balances are entered manually and are not changed by imported transactions.

preview.caption: This is what your overview will look like
preview.captionAccount: The overview after the first account
preview.fills: fills in with the first account and a statement import
preview.afterAccount: the first account exists; a statement import adds the movements
